title: Mark Wahlberg developing affordable longevity gym
excerpt: Mark Wahlberg is launching a new gym concept aimed at providing longevity services without high costs.
body_html:
Actor Mark Wahlberg is developing a new fitness concept focused on longevity, aiming to offer services typically associated with expensive startups at a more accessible price point.

Affordable Wellness Services

The proposed gym concept promises various health and wellness offerings without requiring customers to have substantial financial resources. According to the details provided, members can expect access to amenities such as cold plunges, blood panels, and protein muffins.

Wahlberg previously invested in another gym chain that was eventually removed from the New York Stock Exchange. The new venture is positioned as a counterweight to the costly trend currently dominating the longevity startup space.
